name: skill-crystallizer
description: Crystallizes reusable patterns into SKILL.md files without writing code. Safer, more composable than tool-weaver. Modes: crystallize, list, view, prune, compose.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Mode: crystallize, list, view, prune, compose

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Skill name (kebab-case, used as directory name)

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Brief description of what the skill does

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Multi-line numbered instructions for the skill

inputs.name: trigger_description
inputs.description: Keywords/phrases that should auto-load this skill

inputs.name: dependencies
inputs.description: Comma-separated skill names this depends on

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Result with skill_path, registration status, graph_node_id
